title: A practical guide for assessing respiratory burst and phagocytic cell activity in the fathead minnow, an emerging model for immunotoxicity
author: Hampton, Jeffries, et al.
materials: Sterile cell media (supplemented Leibovitz's L-15 cell media (catalog #L5520, Sigma Aldrich)); Fetal Bovine Serum 5% (catalog #F4135, Sigma Aldrich), Penicillin/Streptomycin 1% (catalog #P4333, Sigma Aldrich), 1.5 M HEPES 1% (catalog #H4034, Sigma Aldrich), L-Glutamine 0.5% (catalog #G7513, Sigma Aldrich)–stored at 4 °C
Nitroblue tetrazolium (NBT) (catalog #N6639, Sigma Aldrich) Stock Solution (2.5 mg/mL) prepared in Hank's Balanced Salt

Bovine superoxide dismutase (SOD) (catalog #S5395, Sigma Aldrich) (Stock Solution (300 µg/mL) prepared in HBSS–stored at −20 °C–Note: Consider the use of membrane-permeable SOD; see section titled, Respiratory Burst: Erythrocyte Lysis and Superoxide Dismutase
Fluorescein (FITC) conjugated Escherichia coli K-12 BioParticles (0.5 mg/mL) prepared in HBSS and 2 mM sodium azide (catalog #E2861, ThermoFisher Scientific)–stored at 4 °C–protected from light

steps.title: Prepare syringes with glass wool
steps.instruction: Loosely pack each sterile 1 mL syringe with sterilized glass wool using forceps and an unwound paper clip that has been doused in 70 % EtOH.

steps.title: Aliquot cell media into tubes
steps.instruction: Pipette 100 µL of sterile, supplemented Leibovitz’s L‑15 cell media into each sterile 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube (one tube per sample), label with the sample number, and place the tubes on ice outside the hood.

steps.title: Label screw‑cap tubes
steps.instruction: Label two sets of sterile 5 mL screw‑cap tubes according to sample number.

steps.title: Prepare 1:10 dilution tubes
steps.instruction: Pipette 90 µL of the same cell media into a separate set of 1.5 mL Eppendorf tubes, label each with the sample number and the suffix “1:10”.

steps.title: Prepare NBT stock solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve Nitroblue tetrazolium (NBT) to a concentration of 2.5 mg/mL in Hank’s Balanced Salt Solution (HBSS); prepare a fresh stock for each assay.

steps.title: Prepare PMA stock and working solutions
steps.instruction: Make a PMA stock solution of 1 mg/mL in dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO). Dilute this stock to a working solution of 100 µg/mL in HBSS, store at –20 °C, and protect from light.

steps.title: Prepare HBSS fresh
steps.instruction: Prepare Hank’s Balanced Salt Solution (HBSS) fresh for each assay.

steps.title: Prepare SOD stock (optional)
steps.instruction: Dissolve bovine superoxide dismutase (SOD) to 300 µg/mL in HBSS; store at –20 °C. Consider using a membrane‑permeable SOD if required.

steps.title: Plate kidney cells and recover
steps.instruction: Plate kidney cells from adult fathead minnows into Tissue‑Culture‑Treated 96‑well flat‑bottom plates (as previously described) and allow overnight recovery in a 30 °C humidified incubator (CO₂ not required because L‑15 media is used).

steps.title: Add PMA and NBT to wells
steps.instruction: Remove 50 µL of media from the top of each well. Add PMA to achieve final concentrations of 0, 0.5, 1, or 2 µg/mL and add NBT to a final concentration of 0.8 mg/mL. Restore the total well volume to 100 µL with fresh cell media.

steps.title: Incubate assay plates
steps.instruction: Incubate the plates at 30 °C in a humidified incubator for the desired time points: 0, 30, 60, or 120 minutes.

steps.title: Process plates post‑incubation
steps.instruction: Process the plates as described previously (the detailed post‑incubation processing steps are not provided in the source text).
